mission: Make the already-earned cross-project RSI observation and experiment mechanics materially easier for an Agent to use without creating a new research authority, daemon, central database, effect kernel, scorer, or problem selector.
questionOrHypothesis: P0-P3: a thin durable scientific-instrument surface can reduce cross-owner evidence plumbing, repeated experiment-matrix mechanics, analytical context load, and revision-delta archaeology while preserving owner truth and Agent scientific judgment.
evidenceSelection: Current Host, Harness, Runtime exporter implementations; one live deployed Host state root, one current-code disposable Harness owner store, one exact Job from the long-lived live Runtime Registry, a 12-trial mechanical fault matrix, the current ten-project world-model frontier, and current active package/tool regression tests.
strongBaseline: Manual owner-export invocation plus nested JSON inspection; one-off per-experiment cell/replicate runners; Agent reading raw trial JSON; existing revision-relation freshness assessor without path/commit evidence.
negativeControl: Do not add continuous collection, priority scoring, topology classification, tractability scoring, semantic completion inference, scientific scoring, or matrix-owned external-effect recovery. If the instruments require those to be useful, P0-P3 fails.
candidate: Promote the three-consumer Observation contract into packages/ordivon-observation-core; add one scripts/ordivon_lab.py CLI with EvidencePack, Matrix, DuckDB/Parquet analysis, query, and PressurePack mechanics; retain all semantic judgment outside the tools.
independentOracle: Current owner exporter tests and contracts, exact owner revisions/bundle digests, deterministic active tests, DuckDB query results, Matrix replay counts, current freshness relation output, and full Computing conformance. Product truth remains owner-native.
invalidityConditions: owner exporter data is rewritten by Computing
EvidencePack claims Trial validity or semantic completion
Matrix nonzero/timeout is reinterpreted as scientific failure
Matrix claims effect recovery across the command-to-record crash gap
tests only pass by restoring historical experiment fixtures as active authority
authorityBoundary: Computing owns only shared instrument mechanics and research method. Host/Harness/Runtime/World/domains own facts and effects. Matrix runs commands mechanically; effectful trials require owner-native durable identity/reconciliation. DuckDB/Parquet outputs are rebuildable projections.
stopRule: Stop P0-P3 after current three-owner EvidencePack dogfood, exact Matrix rerun without re-execution, DuckDB analysis, PressurePack dogfood, active tests, contraction audit, and full conformance. Do not add OTel daemon, cost database, fault framework, or closeout service in this phase.
deletionOrNoChangeOutcome: Any promoted historical file without a current consumer is deleted. Experiment-local raw dogfood remains transient; retain compact acceptance evidence and Git history. The long-lived tools must live outside research/experiments.
publicationBoundary: No ordivon-rsi service/repository, Observation daemon/database, Experiment scheduler, scientific scorer, ResearchTaste/tractability service, pressure selector, global telemetry authority, or matrix-owned Effect framework is authorized.
